explication: SIE is a self-hosted inference platform: clients submit embedding, generation, extraction, and related model tasks; server runtimes execute model work, while an optional gateway manages cluster-facing APIs and worker pools. The repository also provides SDKs, MCP tools, and framework/vector-store integrations. The graph preserves documented task families and major control-plane capabilities; some internal links are dashed because the relevant handler and routing implementations were not excerpted.
